Flash animation for Mutter: a 2,260-frame intro animates the Rammstein logo and cross in green light, with a SKIP button.
How to play: Mouse: click SKIP to leave the intro.
Controls: Mouse (click)
Original file '2001 - Mutter.swf' (uncompressed FWS v4, 146,580 bytes). The archive's 'Mutter/' decompiled export has 2,260 frames at 651x401, matching the SWF timeline; texts, scripts and images are preserved in assets/cards/2001-mutter/. Year comes from the archive filename prefix, not a verified release date.

Interactive Ich will visualizer: 1,031 frames at 45 fps in which cursor movement drives generative line drawings ('woistdieMaus', 'mausdelta') and a light mask over video stills.
How to play: Mouse: move the cursor across the stage; the animation reacts to pointer distance and to holding still.
Controls: Mouse movement
The SWF was extracted byte-for-byte from the Flash projector '2001 - Ich will.exe' (uncompressed FWS v5 at offset 376,832; declared length 799,398 bytes); its 1,031 frames match the archive's 'Ich will/' export. The original EXE is preserved in originals/. Companion texts, scripts and images are in assets/cards/2001-ich-will/. Year comes from the archive filename prefix, not a verified release date.

Standalone Mutter piece delivered inside a WinZip self-extracting EXE; the embedded projector SWF (1,077 frames, 12 fps) is built from Mutter-era imagery, including band and face close-up bitmaps.
How to play: Not documented: the archive contains no decompiled export or text file for this binary, so no in-card instructions could be recovered.
SWF extracted from the inner ramm.exe (uncompressed FWS v5 at offset 376,832, 643,921 bytes) that the outer '2002 - Mutter.exe' WinZip SFX contains; the archive has no companion export for it, so 13 embedded JPEGs were recovered from the movie's DefineBitsJPEG2 tags into assets/cards/2002-mutter/images/. The thumbnail is one of those real bitmaps; see PROVENANCE.md. Year comes from the archive filename prefix, not a verified release date.

Benzin Game (2005)
Year 2005
Mute
Volume
80%
Restart
Fullscreen
Playing

French-language promotional game for the Rosenrot single 'Benzin': steer a truck across a field, hit cows and sheep for points, then submit a score, invite a friend or sign up for the newsletter.
How to play: In-card text is French ('JOUER', 'INSTRUCTIONS', 'HISCORES'). No keyboard API (Key.*, onKeyDown) appears in the decompiled actions or in the SWF's string data, so play is mouse/click-based. Score, invitation and newsletter forms post to relative acces/*.php endpoints that no longer exist.
Controls: Mouse
Original file '2005 - Benzin Game.swf' (uncompressed FWS v7, 1,570,054 bytes). The attack/steering logic is only partly present in the archive's decompiled 'Benzin/scripts/' export. NetStream plays relative 'benzin1.flv', which is not in the archive (movies/254.flv exported 0 bytes), so the video segment is missing. Year comes from the archive filename prefix, not a verified release date.

Rosenrot (Single) ecard (475 frames): preloader, uncensored-video announcement and an email form. The text promises video links to newsletter subscribers who signed up by 20 December 2005.
How to play: Mouse: watch/click through; the send form (Email / send) posts to the historical coremailer.universal-music-group.com servlet and cannot complete offline.
Controls: Mouse (click)
Original file '2005 - Rosenrot (Single).swf' (CWS v8, 275,398 bytes on disk). Embedded historical URLs: http://coremailer.universal-music-group.com/mlg/servlet/mlist and http://www.rammstein.de (content references, not provenance). Year comes from the archive filename prefix, not a verified release date.
